slides.text: 8 gym mistakes I'd fix if I could go back
save this. you'll need it at the gym
first one: I used to lift heavy with trash technique and think that meant I was progressing faster.
I used to train in corners or empty rooms scared someone would look at me or laugh. that fear kept me from actually focusing on the lift. I watched people more than my own body.

get a lifting plan that actually adjusts to your week and your goal
try the app
I used to skip upper body because I was scared of getting bulky. completely wrong. upper body training matters for your shape, posture, and overall strength.
I never tracked calories or protein, just ate randomly. trained for months with zero visible change, and once I got my food dialed in, my body changed way more.
I used to stay up late and sleep under 6 hours, then wonder why my energy was trash. sleep is a core part of building muscle, not an afterthought.
I used to show up with no plan, never logged my weights or reps. no wonder there was zero visible progress.
I used to train one muscle obsessively and neglect everything else. balanced training. legs, upper, core, accessories. is what actually builds you evenly.
